view: The 2026-11-17 print was a clear beat and raise: revenue $115.84B, +103% YoY and 6.5% above estimate, with a $130B guide 4.2% above consensus. The stock still fell 10.4% before Friday's SEC report and 22.9% over the week. At about 8.4x forward EPS and 11.7x annualised last-quarter EPS, NVDA is extremely cheap against 75% forecast growth, but only if the reported numbers hold. The reported SEC accounting probe and $118B of guarantees ($105B to one OpenAI campus, 2.2x cash) go straight to that question. Valuation is a cushion, not a floor, until the probe and the 10-Q are clarified.

probabilities.defs: vs price_at_call 125.53 (Fri 2026-11-20 close, weekend run). next_2_weeks: up = close > 131.81 (+5%), down = close < 119.25 (-5%), range between; measured at the close on or before 2026-12-06 (Fri 2026-12-04). this_quarter (last close of 2026-12-31) and next_quarter (last close of 2027-03-31): up = close > 138.08 (+10%), down = close < 112.98 (-10%), range between. up + range + down = 100.

evidence.point: Outside view 33/45/22 (n=259). I move range -15, down +14 and up +1. Daily ATR is 8.5% (structure.atr_daily_pct), so the +/-5% band is narrower than one average day, and the range bucket must shrink. Requested Huang and general-counsel interviews and a Senate Banking hearing (2026-12-01 to 12-03) fall inside the window while the accounting report is unanswered, so I tilt to down. Conditional samples (2w drop <=-15%: 50/50/0, n=4; RSI<=36: 46/23/31, n=13) are small and overlapping, and none of their cases involved an accounting probe. Weak evidence only.

Base rate 50/31/19. I move up -8, range -9 and down +17. The valuation case and the conditional 13w tables (n=4: 100% up, median +32.1%; RSI<=36 n=13: 69% up) argue for up. But SEC enforcement reviews rarely resolve within a quarter, and the late-Feb 2027 print falls inside the window, so I keep a heavy down tail. this_quarter: base 39/43/18 becomes 35/30/35, for the same reasons over 6 weeks.

Q3 FY27 revenue $115.84B: +103% YoY, +20% QoQ, 6.5% above the $108.73B estimate. Data center $107.6B (+110% YoY) is 92.9% of revenue. Adj EPS 2.68 vs 2.47 est (+8.5%). GAAP net income $65.3B is a 56.4% net margin. On the reported numbers, growth is not decelerating.

Margins: GAAP gross 74.8%, adjusted 74.9%, operating 66.9%. The Q4 gross-margin guide of 71-72% (Vera Rubin ramp) is about 3.4 points lower at the midpoint. My 2026-11-15 trigger 'gross margin below 72%' is partly met on the guide, not on the reported quarter. It is a ramp-cost explanation, not lost pricing power, but it is the first number to check in late Feb.

Q4 guide $130B +/-3% (about $126.1B-$133.9B). That is +12.2% QoQ and 4.2% above the $124.8B consensus, and it assumes zero China data-center revenue (China Hopper shipped last quarter: $2.4B, about 2.1% of revenue). The guide is conservative on China. The next-FY growth forecast is 75%. Before the print I said a beat-and-raise of this size would favour a tactical upgrade. It did not: the stock fell from 162.85 to 145.98 (-10.4%) by Thursday, before the SEC report. The market was not trading the level of the numbers.

Valuation vs its own growth: P/E TTM 15.68, forward about 8.4x (implies forward EPS of about 14.94, derived), and about 11.7x annualised last-quarter adj EPS (2.68 x 4 = 10.72, derived). Market cap $3.03T is about 5.8x the annualised Q4 guide ($520B) and about 11.6x annualised GAAP net income (derived). P/S TTM is not in the slice. A PEG near 0.1 on 75% growth is not a normal discount. The market is either pricing peak-cycle earnings or doubting the earnings themselves. Treat 'cheap' as conditional on the numbers being reliable.

Guarantees rose from $108.5B to $118B (+$9.5B, +8.8%). $105B (89%) is a single OpenAI Ohio campus guarantee, and $0 has been paid so far. That is 2.2x cash and securities ($53.5B), about $4.9 per share and about 3.9% of market cap (derived from market cap/price). Full loss on the guarantees would not explain a 48.4% drawdown. The real risk is second-order: if any revenue is backed by Nvidia's own guarantees, both revenue quality and accounting treatment are in question. The subject of the SEC review is not in the slice.

Friday 2026-11-20: -14.0% after the Reuters report that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues. The close was 0.8% above the low on 3.9x average volume. The probe is not covered by any approved thesis break. For fundamentals it is the most important item, because it attacks the reliability of every figure above. Capital use is also busy: a buyback boost, the planned $12.9B Hugging Face purchase under DOJ review, and the guarantees, all against $53.5B of cash.

Analyst group (counted once): average target cut from 286.12 to 242.79 (Reuters 2026-11-18: 251.74). The median after Q3 is 222.5, which is 77% above price. Summit downgraded to Hold, and Wells Fargo cut its target from 300 to 250 but stays Overweight. These targets mostly predate Friday's SEC report, and a ~90% gap to price means they carry almost no information now. Watch for target cuts that cite accounting, not for the average.
0 of 4 hyperscalers falling (run-rate vs TTM: MSFT +15.9%, GOOGL +28.5%, AMZN +43.6%, META +30.0%; read 2026-11-15, no new quarter since). Demand is not what broke. No TB4 signal.

7/14 pages ok. sec_filings is stale (partial: only the 8-K read), so the Q3 10-Q (guarantee footnotes, any SEC-inquiry disclosure, auditor language) is unknown to me. Q3 FCF and total debt are not in the slice, so last quarter's cash-conversion question cannot be checked. Options are deferred, so the implied move is unknown. The data is ok, but the probe raises a question about the data itself. These gaps cut my confidence to 33 (42 last run).

key_levels.why: 10x forward EPS (derived 14.94 x 10). Sits just above the 143.73-145.71 gap. A reclaim would mean the market is re-trusting the numbers, not just bouncing.
12x annualised last-quarter adj EPS (10.72 x 12, derived). Price is just below it: the stock now trades below a 12x multiple on numbers already reported.
7.5x forward EPS (derived). Almost the same as the -10% quarter threshold 112.98. Below it the market is pricing estimate cuts or a restatement, not a multiple.
10x annualised last-quarter adj EPS (derived). A deep-value floor only if the reported quarter survives the SEC review. 1q -20% reached in 23.1% of windows (reachable).

what_would_change_my_mind: By 2026-12-04: Nvidia confirms a formal SEC investigation or subpoena (8-K or 10-Q) concerning revenue recognition or the guarantees. Effect: 2w down +10, next_quarter up -10, and I would withdraw the valuation-based accumulation case until scope is known.
By 2026-12-04: the company or the SEC states there is no inquiry, or the Reuters report is materially walked back. Effect: 2w up +10, next_quarter up to about 52 (the 8.4x valuation would reassert).
Before 2027-03-31: any restatement, delayed 10-Q/10-K filing, auditor resignation or qualified opinion. That would invalidate the reported EPS I value on, so up drops to 20 or below in every horizon.
Before 2027-03-31: guarantees_paid above $0, or total guarantees disclosed above $118B. The guarantee risk would move from contingent to realised. next_quarter down +8.
Before 2027-03-31: Q4 revenue preannounced or reported below $126.1B (bottom of guide), or gross margin below 71%. That would make the slowdown real, and up would drop by about 10 in next_quarter.

Daily close above 145.71 (top of the gap, +16.1%) before 2026-12-31. 6w +10% reached in 54.5% and +20% in 28.2% of windows: reachable. It would show the market discounting the probe, and next_quarter up +6.

Daily close below 112.98 (-10%) before 2026-12-31 with consensus forward EPS unchanged. 6w -10% reached in 37.8% of windows: reachable. That would be 7.5x on unrevised estimates. If estimates hold and no filing problem appears, I would raise next_quarter up by 5. If estimates fall with it, no change.
notes_for_chair: Before vs after the print (rule 9): before, I said a beat-and-raise with margin held favours a tactical upgrade. The beat-and-raise came (revenue +6.5% vs est, guide +4.2% vs consensus, gross margin 74.9%), and the stock still fell 10.4% before the SEC report. Proposed lessons-log line: 'after a governance shock, the bar was credibility of the numbers, not the numbers; a beat did not lift the stock'.

Expected (not triggers): NVDA ex-dividend 2026-12-02; the Q4 FY27 print in late Feb 2027 (date not confirmed) falls inside next_quarter; the remote-access-rule license deadline is around 2027-02-17. The requested Huang (12-01, 12-03) and general-counsel (12-02) sessions are 'requested', not confirmed. Their outcomes matter, not their dates.

Stance (fundamentals lens): strategic Accumulate is justified on valuation alone (8.4x forward, ~12x reported run-rate EPS, 75% forecast growth, 0/4 capex cuts). I downgrade it to Wait until the accounting question has a first answer: a company statement, or a clean Q3 10-Q that discloses the guarantees and any inquiry. Tactical: Avoid New Entry through 2026-12-04, with hearings and a possible disclosure inside the window. Cross-lane: my slice does not state TB2's status. The 2026-11-15 chair ruled TB2 FIRED (not owner-confirmed). If that still stands, all buying stays paused whatever this view says.

Proposal for the owner (thesis break gap, not applied): the SEC accounting probe is not covered by TB1-TB4. Candidate TB5: 'Accounting integrity: Nvidia discloses a formal SEC investigation into revenue recognition or related-party/guarantee accounting, or any restatement, delayed periodic filing, or auditor resignation/qualified opinion.' Like the others, any one would pause all buying. A press report alone (today's state) is a WATCH, not a fire. Owner approval required.

Ladder proposal (fundamentals/valuation view, propose only, owner approves; no order is to be placed): (1) Price sits in the proposed L4 zone (prior chair file, not in my slice). On valuation alone this zone is justified, at about 8.4x forward. (2) Do not add weight at lower prices just because they are cheaper on the current EPS. If the probe cuts E, a lower price is not cheaper. I propose anchoring any deeper level to forward-EPS multiples and re-marking it each run to consensus: about 112 (7.5x forward, matches the -10% band) and about 107 (10x reported run-rate EPS). If consensus forward EPS is cut, these levels move down in proportion. (3) Hold back a meaningful share of budget, for example a third, as a 'credibility tranche' released by a milestone, not a price: clean 10-Q with guarantee and inquiry disclosure, or the SEC/company statement. Paying up after clarity is the correct trade-off when the risk is binary information, not volatility. (4) Rows L1-L3 above price stay as audit history. I do not propose re-entering them before a fundamental clarification.

Ladder invalidation (proposal): pause or drop the deeper levels if any candidate-TB5 event occurs, guarantees_paid rises above 0, the Q4 guide is cut or Q4 revenue lands below $126.1B, the consensus next-FY growth forecast falls well below 75% (for example under 50%), or TB4 fires.

Data gaps for the next fact sheet: Q3 FCF, total debt and cash flow (to resolve last run's FCF-halving/debt-tripling question); the Q3 10-Q text (guarantee footnote, legal proceedings, any SEC disclosure); P/S TTM; and whether revenue tied to the guaranteed OpenAI campus is recognised. Each is 'not in slice' today.
Anchoring check: the 242.79 average target and the 243.37 ATH both pull toward 'deep value at 125'. Neither should set ladder size. The 8.4x multiple is only as good as the E behind it.

Pre-mortem: if this is badly wrong in three months, the likeliest reason up-side is that the probe proved narrow or unfounded and an 8x stock re-rated fast (the n=4 table was right), and my down tails cost entries. Down-side: guarantee-backed revenue is restated, so forward EPS was never 14.9, and a 'cheap' ladder averaged into impaired earnings.
